newsitem.title: USA: Cheung Labs names Volk president/CEO.
newsitem.headline: Cheung Labs names Volk president/CEO.

text.p: Cheung Laboratories Inc said its board has elected Spencer Volk as president, chief executive officer and director, effective immediately.
The hyperthemia medical equipment manufacturer said that Volk, 63, replaces Verle Blaha, who has resigned.
Volk, a turnaround expert for companies in trouble, was most recently president and chief operating officer at Sunbeam Corp's Sunbeam International, the small-applicance maker.

He was also previously an executive at PepsiCo Inc's PepsiCo International, where he oversaw its Canadian and Latin American operations and was president of Church & Dwight Co Inc, the maker of Arm and Hammer home products.
